description: Xeon Phi 3120A/3120P (57 cores, 1.1 GHz, 6 GB GDDR5, 240 GB/s peak). Card constants are Intel's published specification. Core timing in cycles is inherited from core-x100-measured (measured on the project's 7120-class card; same core design, not re-measured on a 3120). Memory latency and the per-core memory service rate are the 7120 figures converted from nanoseconds at this card's clock (assumed: same memory path). No bandwidth is known. The project's '--profile 3100' runs limit threads and memory on the 7120 card; they are not 3120 measurements.

calibration.statement: Core timing is transferred from the 7120-class card; memory latency is converted from its nanoseconds; nothing was measured on a 3120. Every result is an unvalidated scenario estimate for this card.

card.model.source: Intel product specification (ark.intel.com, Xeon Phi Coprocessor 3120A/3120P)

card.usable_cores.source: one core reserved for the card OS; not measured

latency.memory.source: 7120-class card S6-03 memory.load_lat 356.53 cycles at 1.238 GHz = 288 ns, converted at 1.1 GHz; not measured on a 3120
latency.memory.uncertainty: assumes the same GDDR5 and ring latency in nanoseconds

memory.core_service_cycles_per_line.source: 7120-class card: 20 cycles per line at 1.238 GHz = 16.2 ns, converted at 1.1 GHz; not measured on a 3120
